name: Historical immune ledger v2: native shared-evidence qualification
evidence_class: One native model task with eight checkpoint-paired arms; primary control invalid.
decision: Preserve as a diagnostic failure case; retire this version as a vehicle for broad immunity claims.

interest.judgment: Useful mechanistic question; limited scientific novelty in this implementation.
interest.why: Separating resident shared corruption from private corruption and returning stale records identifies why a superficial repair can relapse.
interest.novelty_boundary: An oracle controller knows the damaged entries and restores checkpoints. This tests conditional repair effects, not autonomous detection, learned institutional immunity or operational resilience.

robustness.supported: Task 6200 records all eight outcomes. Q11 achieves 18/18 useful requests versus Q10F 7/18, but Q10F contains a response-contract failure; complete-valid primary pairs equal zero. Q01 succeeds natively despite the scripted prediction.
robustness.unsupported: Population effects, stable treatment rankings, reliable schema adherence and necessity of private restoration.
robustness.unit: The shared pre-incident task trajectory and its paired branches; rounds and actors are dependent observations.
robustness.independent_variation: One task, dose 1, seed 1. Seed randomizes arm order, not provider sampling.
robustness.assessment: Large within-task differences are diagnostically interesting but do not compensate for one task and an invalid primary comparator.

scenario_quality.size: Eight actors and twelve records suffice to expose state contamination; more actors would add cost before information.
scenario_quality.challenge: Native endorsement failure shows interface difficulty, not necessarily sophisticated reasoning.
scenario_quality.complexity: Twenty-four rounds exercise persistence and replay, but exact ledger copying dominates cognition.
scenario_quality.realism: A useful abstraction of stale state; no actual dependency diagnosis, service deployment or adaptive adversary.
scenario_quality.definition: Timing and objective completion are explicit; historical malformed-response and retention problems limit measurement validity.

controls.retain: CLEAN, N and the shared-restoration × blocking factorial with private restoration fixed.
controls.missing: No-replay, sham intervention and legitimate-learning controls were needed; v3 supplies them.
controls.confounds: Oracle repair, revoked capacity, inherited histories, fixed task and provider variation.

name: Historical immune ledger v3: five-scenario scripted repair instrument
evidence_class: 720 scripted outcomes; prospective native ledger qualification was superseded by the operational scenario pilot.
decision: Keep as a compact mechanism regression suite; do not present fixture success as model research.

interest.judgment: Better falsification design than v2; modest standalone discovery value.
interest.why: It tests collateral loss from rollback and failure when lineage is unavailable, rather than ensuring every repair succeeds.
interest.novelty_boundary: Selective restoration receives oracle damage knowledge. Scripted superiority over broad rollback largely follows the implemented rules.

robustness.supported: All 720 outcomes reconcile. Broad rollback loses legitimate learning; missing lineage permits recurrence; clean controls succeed.
robustness.unsupported: Native effectiveness of v3, autonomous selective diagnosis, production safety and general memory retention.
robustness.unit: Task/scenario trajectory with checkpoint-paired intervention branches.
robustness.independent_variation: Sixteen task IDs change names, values, target relevance and ownership across five mechanisms; deterministic policies supply no native execution variance.
robustness.assessment: Mechanism coverage improves, but 720 branches are neither 720 independent incidents nor evidence of statistical power.

scenario_quality.size: Adequate state-space for a unit-level repair demonstration; twelve records are not twelve realistic tasks.
scenario_quality.challenge: Meaningful rollback tradeoff, but highest-version copying makes many outcomes predictable.
scenario_quality.complexity: Multiple state locations and delayed updates are useful; inference and constrained action planning remain shallow.
scenario_quality.realism: Abstract state-repair model; fixed oracle labels and trustworthy lineage are strong assumptions.
scenario_quality.definition: Scenarios and branch timing are well defined. Retention against obsolete original truth mismeasures successful updates and needs corrected derived metrics.

scenarios.assessment: Main resident-state/replay mechanism.
scenarios.improvement: Retain; test uncertainty in evidence authority later.

scenarios.improvement: Vary which newly learned facts matter; score current truth.

scenarios.improvement: Later distinguish missing, incorrect and forged provenance.

scenarios.improvement: Preserve separate baselines.

scenarios.assessment: Private restoration without/with blocking.
scenarios.improvement: Keep response failures outside mechanism labels.

scenarios.improvement: Retain because native v2 contradicted scripted necessity claims.

scenarios.name: Q11R / Q11
scenarios.assessment: Both stores restored without/with blocking.
scenarios.improvement: Maintain identical pre-intervention histories.

scenarios.name: Q11S
scenarios.assessment: Oracle selective repair preserves unrelated learning.
scenarios.improvement: Label oracle upper bound; compare learned selection only separately.

scenarios.name: CLEAN
scenarios.assessment: Uncorrupted competence reference.
scenarios.improvement: Require valid sustained success before defining recovery.

controls.retain: All five scenarios and factorial ablations as inexpensive deterministic regressions.
controls.missing: For autonomous claims: imperfect detector, false-positive repair and a non-oracle selection policy.
controls.confounds: Shared-history dependence, removal of a source seat, programmed policy, target relevance and obsolete-truth retention metric.

parameters.reason: Successful revision must not count as forgetting.

parameters.reason: Alias changes do not establish domain transfer.

parameters.proposed_variation: Imperfect detection and variable delay as distinct factors
parameters.reason: Needed for autonomy claims, not basic bookkeeping validation.

name: Operational immune scenario redesign: engineering A1/A2, native A1/A2 and solo A1
evidence_class: 384 unique scripted episodes plus 28 native episodes; exploratory architecture and memory comparisons.
decision: Keep as a transparent negative/partial pilot; redesign competence checks before more model experiments.

interest.judgment: Scientifically more interesting than copying the ledger.
interest.why: Recovery must satisfy compatibility, persisted-data and feature constraints while preserving a healthy system. Safe restraint and successful repair compete.
interest.novelty_boundary: Three fully specified services are a constructed reasoning exercise. Native errors are real observations, but neither immunity nor reviewer causation is established.

robustness.supported: Replays and summaries reconcile. A1 harms healthy controls. A2 preserves them but fails eight of nine damaged episodes. Solo repairs all three incidents but harms the healthy control.
robustness.unsupported: Stable architecture rankings, revision-filter benefits, realistic incident frequency and causal explanation from model justifications.
robustness.unit: Scenario episode; repeated steps and reviewer outputs are dependent measurements.
robustness.independent_variation: Four constructed cases, one native sample per cell; engineering suffixes are presentation variants. A1/A2 change multiple presentation factors.
robustness.assessment: Good falsifying pilot, insufficient robustness. Fixed team/solo order and provider variability prevent isolating reviewer effects.

scenario_quality.size: Three services and six actions are enough to reveal basic failures; enlargement is premature.
scenario_quality.challenge: Already challenging for this model/interface despite a deterministic solver succeeding; difficulty is demonstrated, realism is not.
scenario_quality.complexity: Relational constraints and irreversible data are substantive; full observability and one-time advice simplify diagnosis.
scenario_quality.realism: Plausible failure mechanisms, invented incidents. No real workload, uncertainty, network dynamics or authenticated provenance.
scenario_quality.definition: Multiple feasible bundles and customer checks improve validity; source/catalog export is still needed to independently verify those checks.

scenarios.improvement: Retain alongside damaged-task competence, not alone.

scenarios.improvement: Later vary whether missing evidence is actually necessary.

scenarios.improvement: Factor misleading-memory presence with policy before interpreting treatment effects.

scenarios.improvement: Retain as reference, not independent operational evidence.

scenarios.improvement: Do not treat their difference as a single-factor causal effect.

scenarios.improvement: Interleave paired architecture runs on fresh cases after qualification.

controls.missing: Mandatory clean damaged-task baseline and independent scenario authorship; then a controlled reviewer intervention.
controls.confounds: Presentation amendment, fixed order, unequal architecture cost, one sample, model variation and mixed unsafe/deployment labels.

name: Collective-sensing methods-guide toy
evidence_class: Deterministic majority-policy simulation; illustrative inference, no LLM evidence.
decision: Keep as an analytical teaching/calibration example; redesign before claiming a swarm discovery.

interest.judgment: Clear pedagogical value; limited novelty as an experiment.
interest.why: It cleanly distinguishes repeated messages from independent evidence and demonstrates paired, clustered analysis.
interest.novelty_boundary: Deduplicating known source identities changes an explicit majority rule. Its expected effect is analytically calculable; simulation does not discover LLM behavior.

robustness.supported: All 960 outcomes reconcile: observed primary difference .0625; illustrative interval [.0125,.1125]. Analytical population difference is .05497875 under the generator.
robustness.unsupported: Emergent communication, reasoning, autonomous source tracking, human behavior or general provenance-instruction effectiveness.
robustness.unit: Paired world episode; scenario-level sensor quality supplies clustering.
robustness.independent_variation: Sixty sampled quality parameters with four fresh signal/truth repetitions each; five within-world decisions are dependent.
robustness.assessment: Strong bookkeeping example. Sixty values of one parameter are not sixty distinct reasoning task families.

scenario_quality.size: Five sources distinguish ring from global visibility; additional identical global agents add no scripted information.
scenario_quality.challenge: Binary voting with perfect source labels is easy and fully specified.
scenario_quality.complexity: One decision phase, no memory adaptation, tools or agent-generated messages.
scenario_quality.realism: Abstract duplicate-evidence problem; equal-quality conditionally independent sensors are restrictive.
scenario_quality.definition: Excellent explicit generator and claim boundaries; retained artifact semantics verified despite validator gaps.

scenarios.name: naive_global
scenarios.assessment: Counts seven messages, overweighting source zero; deliberately weak mechanism control.
scenarios.improvement: Use competent ordinary aggregation for native testing.

scenarios.name: provenance_global
scenarios.assessment: Counts five unique sources; identical scripted decisions.
scenarios.improvement: Separate instruction effects from deduplication code.

scenarios.name: no_communication
scenarios.assessment: Private signal only; evidence reach differs.
scenarios.improvement: Keep descriptive, not an isolated communication-effect estimate.

scenarios.name: provenance_ring
scenarios.assessment: Three-source neighborhoods; topology and information differ.
scenarios.improvement: Match delivered evidence if topology itself is the estimand.

controls.retain: Paired signals/truth, analytical oracle and explicitly scripted baselines.
controls.missing: For LLM claims: no-duplicate negative control, competent single classifier, independent ensemble and fixed aggregate budget.
controls.confounds: Naive rule guarantees susceptibility; global agents repeat the same computation; topology changes evidence reach.
